generator.name: Power Station
generator.description: Supplies connected facilities through power links.

solar.name: Solar Array
solar.description: High-density late-game generator: 30 base power in 2 slots, +100% base output per level; specialized solar research and talents amplify it.

mine.name: Ore Extractor
mine.description: Pulls raw ore from beneath the factory.

smelter.name: Smelter
smelter.description: Converts raw ore into refined metal.

etcher.name: Circuit Etcher
etcher.description: Etches circuits out of refined metal.

assembler.name: Assembly Line
assembler.description: Combines parts and circuits into devices.

lab.name: Research Lab
lab.description: Studies finished devices to produce research data.

market.name: Trade Terminal
market.description: Accepts goods through its left input for sales or contracts. It has no output or power requirement; metal sells automatically unless disabled.

warehouse.name: Warehouse
warehouse.description: Stores up to 600 units of each material and routes goods onward. Upgrade to expand its buffer.

fusion.name: Fusion Foundry
fusion.description: Engineer-only advanced metal producer: 7 Ore/s → 4.5 Refined Metal/s.

quantumlab.name: Quantum Research Lab
quantumlab.description: Scientist-only advanced lab converting Devices into Research Data at high speed.
